description: Controls shading devices like blinds, curtains, and awnings

inputs.name: Toggle
inputs.description: Switches between open, stop, and close states using a single button control

inputs.name: Partial open
inputs.description: Activates opening when the button is pressed and held

inputs.name: Partial close
inputs.description: Activates closing when the button is pressed and held

inputs.name: Full open
inputs.description: Fully opens the shading device; stops movement if already in motion

inputs.name: Full close
inputs.description: Fully closes the shading device; stops movement if already in motion

inputs.name: Slightly open
inputs.description: Venetian blinds close completely and move slats to the horizontal position based on the configured 'slightly open duration'. Roller blinds, curtains, and awnings move to the slightly open position according to the same parameter.

inputs.name: Wind alarm
inputs.description: Moves shading to a safe position during high wind conditions and locks the controls

inputs.name: Door window contact
inputs.description: Automatically opens the shading device when a door or window is detected open

inputs.name: Off
inputs.description: Stops shading device movement when active and blocks other operations

inputs.name: Position
inputs.description: Moves the shading device to the specified position as a percentage (0=fully closed, 100=fully open)

inputs.name: Slats
inputs.description: Moves the slats of venetian blinds to the specified angle given as a percentage (0=vertical, 50=horizontal, 100=closed)

outputs.name: Open
outputs.description: Activates when the shading device should be opening.

outputs.name: Close
outputs.description: Activates when the shading device should be closing.

outputs.name: Position
outputs.description: Represents the current position of the shading device as a percentage (0=fully closed, 100=fully open)

outputs.name: Slats position
outputs.description: Represents the current angle of slats as a percentage (0=vertical, 50=horizontal, 100=closed)

config.name: Shading type
config.description: Defines the type of shading device: Venetian blinds, Roller blinds, Curtains (both sides), Curtains (left), Curtains (right), Awning

config.name: Opening duration
config.description: The time taken to fully open the shading device, in seconds

config.name: Closing duration
config.description: The time taken to fully close the shading device, in seconds

config.name: Return duration
config.description: Return duration to position the shading device slightly open from fully open position. For venetian blinds, duration for horizontal alignment of slats.

config.name: Wind alarm position
config.description: The position of the shading device during wind alarm activation, as a percentage of fully open (0-100)

config.name: Motor lock duration
config.description: Time required to release the motor lock between direction changes, in seconds

state.name: Position
state.description: Raw value of the output position as a percentage (0-100), not rounded

state.name: Desired position
state.description: Desired position. Used only to pass values between callback executions

state.name: Slats position
state.description: Raw value of the slats position as a percentage (0-100), not rounded

state.name: Desired slats position
state.description: Desired slats position. Used only to pass values between callback executions

state.name: Steps left
state.description: Number of steps remaining for completing the current movement

state.name: Steps left for slats
state.description: Number of steps remaining for completing the current movement for slats

state.name: Was opening
state.description: Indicates whether the previous movement was in the opening direction

state.name: Last movement timestamp
state.description: Timestamp of the last movement of the shading device used to add a motor lock pause on direction change
